greeting_formal: Hello, I am calling from the bank.
greeting_with_name: Hello, I am calling from the bank. May I speak with {customer_name}?
wrong_party: I apologize for the inconvenience. Could you please pass the phone to {customer_name}?
disclosure_recording: Before we proceed, I want to inform you that this call is being recorded for quality and training purposes. Do you acknowledge this?
disclosure_refuse: I understand. We cannot proceed without your acknowledgment. We will contact you through other means. Thank you.
purpose_bounce: I'm calling regarding your loan for {product_type}. Your recent EMI payment of Rs. {emi_amount} could not be processed.
purpose_reminder: This is a friendly reminder that your EMI of Rs. {emi_amount} is due on {due_date}.
payment_when: When would you be able to make the payment of Rs. {overdue_amt}?
payment_partial: Any payment helps. How much can you pay, and when?
ptp_confirm: To confirm - you will pay Rs. {ptp_amount} on {ptp_date}. Is this correct?
ptp_confirmed: Excellent. I have recorded your promise to pay Rs. {ptp_amount} by {ptp_date}.
ptp_sms: You will receive an SMS with payment details and a UPI link.
dispute_escalate: I understand your concern. I will escalate this to our team who will contact you within 48 hours.
paid_claim: Thank you for informing. Could you please share the payment reference or transaction ID?
paid_verify: Thank you. We will verify this and update our records.
hardship_understand: I understand this is a difficult time. Can you pay at least a partial amount?
hardship_escalate: I understand. I will have our support team contact you.
human_transfer: I will transfer you to one of our representatives. Please hold.
callback: I will have someone call you back. Thank you.
closing_thanks: Thank you for speaking with me today. We appreciate your cooperation.
closing_goodbye: Thank you for your time. Have a good day. Goodbye.
technical_error: I'm experiencing a technical issue. Please call our customer service. Goodbye.
unclear_repeat: I didn't catch that. Could you please repeat?
unclear_escalate: I'm having trouble hearing you. Let me connect you to someone who can help.
